data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter library for freehand drawing with pressure support and variable line width.
data.what_it_does: Scribble provides a drawing surface widget and a notifier to handle freehand sketches in Flutter. It supports pen and touch pressure, variable line widths, image export to PNG, JSON serialization, and full undo/redo capabilities.
use_when: You need to implement freehand drawing or signature capture in your Flutter app.
You need pressure-sensitive drawing with variable line widths.
You want to serialize sketches to JSON and export them to PNG images.
avoid_when: You are building a complex vector graphics editor or a full-featured digital painting application requiring layer management and advanced brushes.
You only need to display static graphics without drawing input.
strengths: Supports pressure and variable line width for smooth freehand drawing.
Sketches are fully serializable to JSON and exportable to PNG.
weaknesses: Limited to freehand drawing and basic sketching use cases.
Relies on specific internal value notifier tools which may limit deep customization.
data.setup_notes: Install via `dart pub add scribble` and add the Scribble widget with a ScribbleNotifier to your widget tree.
